info.title: Geomacro x402 Testnet Intelligence API
info.description: Structured, derived intelligence only. Raw source data is never delivered through this API.

post.summary: Buy structured Geomacro intelligence per call
post.description: A deliverable unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED. After valid x402 testnet payment, the same bound query returns structured derived intelligence.

200.description: Paid structured intelligence response. execution_authorized is always false.

402.description: Payment required after no-charge deliverability validation.

422.description: Not currently fully deliverable; no payment is accepted.
